betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Tired of carrying individual storage cells around? The ME Drive holds up to 10 storage cells in a single block and exposes them all to the network.

Each cell slot has an LED indicator: green means the cell has items, orange is full, blue is empty, and red means the cell is partitioned. Handy for spotting which drives need attention at a glance.

Drives use 1 channel when connected to a controller network. Build a room of drives for a proper storage system, and use the ME Chest for quick early-game storage until you can afford drives.

§ePS:§f The drive accepts any AE2 storage cell: item cells, fluid cells, and spatial cells all work.
